roles.definition: Senior executive accountable for the data domain and its appropriate use.
Establishes and authorises official master or reference lists (e.g. national registers, code lists).
Ensures business quality, fit for purpose and ongoing maintenance.
Operates the authoritative source system(s) for the data.
Provides secure access (e.g. APIs, data products) and technical operations.
Accountable for appropriate use of data in their domain or service.
Sets direction, policy, standards and oversight for government data.
Ensures legal, privacy, security and classification requirements are met.
